title: The Importance of the Sun
text_content:
The sun is the main source of energy for Earth.
Plants use sunlight to make their own food.
Animals depend on plants for energy.
Without sunlight, plants would not grow.
This would affect all living things.

title: Working Dogs
text_content:
Some dogs are trained to do special jobs.
Guide dogs help people who cannot see.
Police dogs help find missing people.
These dogs must be trained carefully.
They are important helpers in society.

title: Saving Water
text_content:
Water is important, but it is not unlimited.
People use water for drinking, cleaning, and farming.
Sometimes, people waste water without noticing.
Turning off taps and fixing leaks can save water.
Saving water helps people and the environment.

title: Why Birds Fly South
text_content:
Some birds fly to warmer places during winter.
Cold weather makes it hard to find food.
Flying south helps them survive.
When the weather becomes warm again, they return.
This movement is part of their life cycle.

title: Balanced Diet
text_content:
A balanced diet includes different kinds of food.
Fruits and vegetables give vitamins.
Rice and bread give energy.
Eating too much of one type is not healthy.
A balanced diet keeps the body strong and active.

title: Trees and Climate
text_content:
Trees help control the Earth’s temperature.
They provide shade and cool the air.
Trees also take in harmful gases.
Cutting too many trees can harm the climate.
Planting trees helps protect the environment.

title: How Fish Survive
text_content:
Fish have special features for living in water.
Gills help them breathe underwater.
Their bodies are shaped to move easily.
Some fish can hide using their colors.
These features help them stay safe from danger.

title: Learning in School
text_content:
School helps children gain knowledge and skills.
They learn subjects like math and science.
They also learn how to work with others.
Teachers guide them through lessons and activities.
Education prepares them for real-life challenges.

title: Heavy Rain Effects
text_content:
Heavy rain can cause flooding in some areas.
Floods can damage homes and roads.
People may need to leave their homes for safety.
However, rain is also needed for plants.
Too much or too little rain can be harmful.

title: Safe Riding
text_content:
Riding a bicycle can be fun and useful.
But safety rules must be followed.
Wearing a helmet protects the head.
Looking both ways prevents accidents.
Following rules keeps riders safe.

title: Why Fruits Matter
text_content:
Fruits are full of vitamins and minerals.
They help the body stay strong.
Eating fruits can prevent sickness.
Different fruits give different nutrients.
Eating a variety is the best choice.

title: Inside the Earth
text_content:
The Earth is made of several layers.
The crust is where we live.
Below it is the mantle, which is very hot.
At the center is the core, which is extremely hot.
These layers work together to form the planet.

title: Keeping Air Clean
text_content:
Air pollution can harm people’s health.
Smoke from cars and factories causes dirty air.
Breathing dirty air can make people sick.
Planting trees and reducing smoke can help.
Everyone can help keep the air clean.

title: Choosing Clothes
text_content:
Clothes protect us from different weather.
Light clothes keep us cool in hot days.
Thick clothes keep us warm in cold weather.
Raincoats protect us from getting wet.
Choosing the right clothes is important.

title: Travel Choices
text_content:
People use different transportation for travel.
Cars are good for short trips.
Planes are faster for long distances.
Trains can carry many people at once.
Choosing the right transport depends on distance and need.
